scope: Two-dimensional flex scroll with fixed or absolute descendants: rows, columns, reverse directions, wrapping/reverse wrapping, RTL and cross-axis center/baseline alignment; horizontal-tb, no anonymous text/contents items, sticky descendants or unresolved auto margins on the shifted axes.
rootCause: An artificial transform on an ordinary flex item establishes a new containing block for both fixed and absolute descendants. The initial horizontal-only fix left the same root cause in diagonal/vertical/column/wrapped and absolute-only layouts.
implementation: Apply opposite physical margin deltas on each scrolled axis to each in-flow flex item. Each pair sums to zero, preserving its outer size and flex-line layout without a new containing block. Flex-item margins do not collapse. Adjust fixed/absolute descendant insets only when their source offsetParent is the original scroller; preserve existing inner/ancestor/viewport anchors. Source mappings are required.
